prompt:
Subject:
Floral pattern on a seaside swing

Main Subject:
The person is placed large in the center of the screen. A mid-thigh vertical photo of a woman standing in front of a wooden swing in a lush seaside garden. Thick ropes on the left and right surround the person, with the sea, lawn, palms, and a gazebo in the background.

Character/Expression:
Head tilted slightly to the right, looking at the camera with a soft expression and lips slightly parted. Slender oval face with a small chin, large almond-shaped eyes, thin eyebrows, small nose tip, glossy pale pink lips. Long light brown hair with thin bangs and loose waves, flowing heavily over one shoulder. Pale pink cheeks.

Clothing/Pose:
An off-the-shoulder cropped top with a pale blue floral pattern on a white background, characterized by short ruffle sleeves and a thin lace-up ribbon at the center of the chest. Raw-edge light blue denim shorts, a thin necklace, and a wide watch on one wrist. Arms hanging naturally, standing with a slight tilt of the hips.

Background/Lighting:
Swing in the foreground, gazebo on the left, greenery on the right, and the sea in the background, with soft primary light from above. Wooden swing seat, lawn, palms, leafy trees, sea with pale island silhouettes, and a thatched-roof gazebo in the back left. Strong midday sunlight is softened by dappled light through the leaves, creating bright rim light on the skin and hair.

Composition/Camera:
Focus on the person, cropping from the head to the thighs at the screen edges, with the background naturally blurred. Person shown large in the center. 3:4 vertical composition, mid-range shot from head to upper thigh. Person in the center, with the ropes arranged as vertical lines on the left and right, and the seat crossing behind the hips. Background is softly blurred enough to identify as a seaside location.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic live-action photo. Fresh and high-definition live-action. Depicts floral patterns, ruffles, denim, wood, and lawn textures in bright blue-green tones.

Negative:
Do not omit the ropes on either side of the swing.
